careerLimitSource: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1 – 600 mSv career effective dose limit
rawDataNote: Raw MSL/Curiosity RAD data: PDS PPI Node (https://pds-ppi.igpp.ucla.edu/). Not converted in this MVP; published peer-reviewed dose rates are used instead.

iss.source: Space agency-specific standards for crew dose and risk assessment of ionising radiation exposures for the ISS (PMC10919966): ~0.2 to ~0.5 mSv/day (midpoint used)

marsTransit.source: Zeitlin et al. 2013, Science 340:1080 – MSL RAD during Earth–Mars cruise

marsBase.source: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343:1244797 – Curiosity RAD on the Martian surface (Gale crater)

moonBase.source: Zhang et al. 2020, Science Advances 6:eaaz1334 – Chang'e-4 LND, lunar surface
